datasets.title: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2020 across the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML formats to track temporal changes in food security conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
